They are all oriented from the equivalence applied to an atom towards its image, and each terminates. Downstream code invokes them explicitly, for example `rw [← planeCurveToBivariate_natDegree_eq_degreeOf_zero]` in WeightedTraceEulerSeven.lean and `simp only [degreeOf_map_eq_of_injective φ hφ]` in ExtensionEvenDegreeStepanovBound.lean.
